svg.text: THE SAME STATE MACHINE READ AS SEQUENCE · COMPANION TO THE STATE DIAGRAM
AN ISOLATED NODE STILL WATERS — AUTONOMOUS CONSERVATIVE CYCLE
POWER LOSS DOES NOT APPEAR IN THIS FLOW
AUTO-RETURN VALVES CLOSE BY PHYSICS. THERE IS NO SOFTWARE STEP, AND SOFTWARE MUST NOT ASSUME IT CAN PREVENT OR DELAY IT.
EVERY DECISION THAT FAILS HAS A DEFINED DESTINATION, AND EVERY DESTINATION RETURNS. THE FLOW HAS NO TERMINAL FAILURE.
